# langfuse_dataset (Data Source)

Look up a dataset by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "langfuse_dataset" "regression" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "regression-suite"
}

output "dataset_id" {
  value = data.langfuse_dataset.regression.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The dataset name.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The dataset description.
- `expected_output_schema` (String) The JSON Schema that expected outputs are validated against.
- `id` (String) The dataset ID.
- `input_schema` (String) The JSON Schema that item inputs are validated against.
- `metadata` (String) The dataset metadata as a JSON value.
